title: Kissed Tender German Almond Skillet
description: A tender and flavorful German dish featuring almonds and a hint of mustard, all cooked in one skillet. This recipe is macrobiotic-friendly and uses agemono-deep-fry techniques.
instructions: Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the sliced almonds and cook until golden brown, about 5 minutes.
Remove the almonds from the skillet and set aside.
Add the chopped onion to the skillet and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chopped carrots and potatoes to the skillet, and cook for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
In a small bowl, whisk together the flour and mustard, and then add the mixture to the skillet, stirring to combine.
Return the cooked almonds to the skillet and season with salt and pepper to taste.
Cook for an additional 2 minutes, stirring constantly, until the mixture is well combined and heated through.
